title: Align compatible shapes, reduce a named axis
description: A quick reference for the broadcasting, elementwise, and explicit-axis reduction terms used here.

terms.definition: Mapping compatible input shapes to one output shape while reusing size-one coordinates.
Comparing shapes from their final axes, with missing leading axes treated as size one.
An axis of extent one whose sole coordinate can be reused across a compatible extent.
Applying the same scalar function independently at every aligned output coordinate.
Combining values along one named axis while preserving the other coordinates.
The explicit tensor axis whose values are grouped by a reduction.
An option that retains a reduced axis with extent one instead of removing it.
The tensor dimension indexing the components of each token's learned representation.
A normalization of attention scores along the source-position axis after numerical stabilization.
Normalizing each token's values with statistics computed across its feature axis.
